subject: MAP: Gated rollout, eval plan & skill-transfer — NovaCare onramp
messages:
From: Dana Lutz <dana.lutz@novacare.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary plan — NovaCare Onramp

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal signed off this morning and procurement said I should coordinate the execution steps with your team so we have a concrete MAP (mutual action plan) that ties the close to the implementation milestones.

High level asks from our side:
- A concise go-live timeline with a defined canary window and rollback criteria.
- An evaluation plan we can run during the canary to validate latency, accuracy on our sample prompts, and data isolation.
- Proposed training dates for our ops and support staff (2 half-day sessions).

We are targeting a soft go-live the week of 2028-08-20 but have flexibility if the canary needs more time. Procurement and our cloud team will want SOC2/KMS details — cc'ing Lucas (cloud lead) and procurement.

Can you send a draft MAP + evaluation checklist by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Dana

Dana Lutz
Director, Product Operations
NovaCare Health

Attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lutz <dana.lutz@novacare.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary plan — NovaCare Onramp

Hi Dana —

Appreciate the note and congrats on getting to signature. I attached an initial MAP workbook that maps milestones to owners, dates, and success gates. Key highlights:

- Phase 0 (Prep): 8/1–8/6 — provisioning, network/KMS onboarding, account-scoped test data (owner: Ben).
- Phase 1 (Canary): 8/7–8/13 — 2-week canary with progressive traffic ramp (10% → 50%). Canary gating: latency P95 < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, embedding cosine stability within 2% of baseline.
- Phase 2 (Training & Ramp): 8/14–8/20 — ops training (2 half-day sessions) + expanded traffic.
- Phase 3 (Go-live): target 8/21 — full route cutover contingent on successful canary metrics and sign-off.

Files attached: MAP_NovaCare_v1.xlsx, canary-schedule.csv.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm the training attendees and preferred dates (we proposed 8/15 + 8/17 AM slots).
2) Confirm the sample prompt set (we uploaded a sample to the Drive link below).
3) Procurement questions: please route SOC2/KMS asks to Ben — he can send the certs and the architecture note.

Quick note on rollback: if at any stage the canary triggers a critical metric breach (P95 > 700ms or error spikes > 2%), we will automatically throttle and fall back to the hosted fallback model and schedule an immediate postmortem.

Link to MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-novacare-map
HubSpot: HS-98321
DocuSign (contract): https://docusign.net/XXXXX-novacare-agreement

Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Customer Success (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding a couple of operational notes:

- We recommend reserving a small dedicated pool for the canary (2x A100-equivalent vGPUs) between 8/7–8/13 to ensure stable latency while we ramp traffic. If you want us to quote reserved capacity for that window, say so and I9ll route to Commercial.
- For evaluation: please validate embeddings batch sizes and typical sequence lengths. We saw some datasets with long notes (2k+ tokens) that change batching behavior; if NovaCare9s samples include those, we9ll adjust the P95 targets.

Ben
Ops Lead, Dedicated Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Lucas Chen <lucas.chen@novacare.io>

Date: 2028-07-31T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary plan — NovaCare Onramp

Appreciate the draft. A couple of items from infra/procurement:
- Need SOC2 Type II report and evidence of key management integration (KMS/HSM). Can you provide the certs and a short architecture note?
- For the canary we9d like to run a parallel baseline for 48 hours (our control environment) to compare inference outputs and latency. Is that supported?
- Please include estimated egress costs for the 2-week canary and the proposed Dedicated pool.

If you can get the SOC2 pdf and KMS note over, procurement will start the payment milestone.

Thanks,
Lucas Chen
Cloud Engineering Lead
NovaCare Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary plan — NovaCare Onramp

Hi Lucas / Dana —

Attached is an evaluation checklist (evaluation-checklist.pdf) that we will run during the canary. Highlights:

- Acceptance tests: functional (semantic accuracy on labeled prompts), performance (latency P50/P95/P99, CPU/GPU utilization), and stability (error spike detection).
- Data integrity tests: ensure no cross-tenant leakage, confirm KMS-wrapped secrets and audit logging are enabled.
- A/B output comparison: we will store feature hashes and sample outputs for the 48-hour baseline you requested and compute a similarity metric for acceptance.

Gating criteria for canary->ramp: all critical functional tests pass and performance metrics are within agreed tolerances for 48 continuous hours. If a critical test fails, we enact the rollback plan in the MAP and convene a Triage within 2 hours.

Proposed training: 8/15 9:00–12:00 (ops + support) and 8/17 9:00–12:00 (dev + integration). Please confirm attendees.

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evaluation-checklist.pdf

Dana / Lucas / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turn. To summarize next steps and owners (so we have a single source of truth in the MAP):

- 7/29: Contract executed (DocuSign completed).
- 8/1–8/6: Prep — infra provisioning (Ben), KMS integration + SOC2 certs delivered (Ben to Lucas).
- 8/7–8/13: Canary — progressive ramp; Redwood runs evaluation-checklist.pdf and feeds results into the MAP workbook.
- 8/9–8/10: NovaCare baseline window (48 hours) running in parallel for A/B comparison (per Lucas request).
- 8/15 & 8/17: Training sessions (confirm attendee list by 8/6).
- 8/14–8/20: Ramp to broader traffic after successful canary sign-off; final cutover 8/21.

Immediate asks for NovaCare:
1) Confirm training attendees and whether the two proposed AM slots work.
2) Share the canonical sample prompt set or grant Drive access to the file in the related_links above.
3) Procurement: confirmation of payment schedule tied to the Phase 1 canary completion triggers so we can provision Dedicated pool as needed.

I will update the MAP workbook with these notes and mark owners in HubSpot (HS-98321). If procurement confirms the payment milestone, Ben will provision the Dedicated capacity window and circulate the SOC2/KMS bundle.

If everyone is aligned I9ll convert the MAP draft to a locked version and send a sign-off request via DocuSign by Friday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
